summary: Cooler fall weather makes this a great weekend for coffee, brunch and a morning hike with your dog. Heads up: David H. Ready Dog Park is closed until December 23, Demuth Park's dog parks are closed until early November, and Ruth Hardy Park's turf is closed until November 20. Coming up next Saturday, October 31: the Hallo Wiener dachshund race in Palm Desert.
heatNote: Expected highs are about 76°F Friday, 81°F Saturday and 82°F Sunday, with no rain in the forecast. Mornings are most comfortable. Bring water and a bowl, and recheck the forecast closer to the day.

picks.name: 4 Paws Coffee Co.
picks.when: Saturday and Sunday, 6:30 am to 3 pm (8 to 9 am is a nice time)
picks.where: 2500 N. Palm Canyon Drive, Suite A5, Palm Springs
picks.why: A neighborhood coffee shop centered on dogs and community, so easy conversations with other dog owners come naturally.
picks.check: Keep your dog leashed and ask about shaded seating and water. 760 832 8021.

picks.name: Boozehounds brunch
picks.when: Friday to Sunday, 10 am to 3 pm
picks.where: 2080 N. Palm Canyon Drive, Palm Springs
picks.why: A restaurant built for dogs and their people, so the tables around you are full of fellow dog owners. Dogs are welcome on the shaded patio and open air atrium.
picks.check: Reserve a dog friendly table and confirm there is no private event. 760 656 0067.

picks.name: Palm Springs Animal Shelter
picks.when: Saturday or Sunday, 11 am to 5 pm
picks.why: A friendly place to meet rescue minded locals and volunteers, and to hear about upcoming adoption events.
picks.check: Call ahead before bringing your own dog, since shelters often ask visitors to leave pets at home.

picks.name: Whitewater Preserve Canyon View Loop
picks.when: Saturday or Sunday, start by 8 am
picks.where: Whitewater Preserve, about 25 minutes northwest of Palm Springs
picks.why: A dog friendly 3.5 mile hike with mountain views, popular with hikers who bring their dogs. The cooler weather makes it a great pick this week.
picks.check: Confirm preserve hours and leash rules, and check wind conditions in the pass before you drive out.

picks.name: Palm Springs Air Museum
picks.where: 745 N. Gene Autry Trail, Palm Springs
picks.why: A fresh outing where friendly, leashed dogs are welcome in the hangars, with plenty of visitors to chat with.
picks.check: Ask about flight demonstrations or loud engine noise before bringing a noise sensitive dog. 760 778 6262.
